title: Issue with BG Trend Arrow When Using Exponential Smoothing and boradcast data to GlugoDataHandler
body:
Hello,

I’m currently using GlucoDataHandler to handle alarms and notifications. I have configured AndriosAPS as the local data source and set up AAPSClient to share data via Samsung Tizen. The data transmission is functioning as expected.

However, when the main smoothing method in AAPS is set to Exponential, GlucoDataHandler consistently shows a question mark instead of the BG trend arrow.

Note: The primary AAPS instance uses Juggluco as the data source, with BG data updated every minute.

Best regards,
Ahmed Saleh

comments.body:
May be this is somehow fixed already in GDH. I have v. 2.0 Beta release in use and ?-mark is not shown after a short test. I have Exponentoal filtering now on and follow this some hours in order to verify that it is fixed.

Note also that GDH has a setting "Trend calculation" and it turns on internal calculation for Trend arrow. I have it now turned off for testing this issue.

> May be this is somehow fixed already in GDH. I have v. 2.0 Beta release in use and ?-mark is not shown after a short test. I have Exponentoal filtering now on and follow this some hours in order to verify that it is fixed.
> 
> Note also that GDH has a setting "Trend calculation" and it turns on internal calculation for Trend arrow. I have it now turned off for testing this issue.

I am using version 1.3.1, will test beta version and see how it goes.

GDH developer explained why GDH v. 2.0 looks like "fixing" the problem. GDH automatically turns on "Internal Trend calculation" if the received data does not contain trend info. There is also a manual setting for "Internal Trend Calculation" but it works also automatically.
